content: Every column `network_loader._route_stop_records` emits must be present. Extra columns are allowed: exports from the raw zone carry the `year`/`month`/`day` partition keys.
960 route-stop memberships on 2026-08-19, across the 119 routes that have stops mapped. A collapse here with routes intact means the relation members were truncated or the role parsing broke.

Referential integrity: every `route_stops` row resolves to a known stop. `parse_network` builds the stops table *from* the ids referenced here and silently skips any node Overpass failed to return (`if node_id in nodes`), so a truncated node list shows up as route_stops referencing more distinct stops than the stops table holds. Because the stops table can never hold a stop that is not referenced, `count(distinct stop_id) == count(stops)` is exactly that check.

The bound is read from the stops validation in the same checkpoint run (`$PARAMETER` URN), which is why `network_stops_suite` runs first and the checkpoint carries `StoreEvaluationParametersAction`. Validating this suite on its own raises `EvaluationParameterError` rather than passing vacuously.
A position, never a float. The type list covers the pandas, Spark and SQL execution engines so the suite can move to Glue unchanged.
Zero-based position along the route, in OSM member order. Not a timetable ordering: there are no times in this data.
The grain of the table: one position per route. Deliberately *not* (`route_id`, `stop_id`) — a loop route may legitimately serve the same stop twice, and one does in the committed sample.

Mirrors `STOP_ROLE_PREFIXES` in network_loader.py: only members whose PTv2 role starts with `stop` or `platform` (`stop`, `stop_3`, `stop_entry_only`, `platform`, ...) are boardable points. A way or an unrelated role getting through means the member filter regressed.

meta.description: Expectations for the raw OSM route-to-stop bridge (route_stops.parquet). Validates presence of the columns network_loader emits, null constraints on both keys, the (route_id, stop_sequence) grain, the PTv2 member-role filter, a minimum row count, and that every row resolves to a known stop — the check that catches an Overpass response whose node list was truncated. One of three suites covering the network snapshot.

content: Validated by `raw_samples_checkpoint` against `data/samples/network/route_stops.parquet`, after `network_stops_suite`, whose observed row count this suite consumes.
